item: Grace period for fines and investigations
primary_value_seen: At least one year; investigations and penalties deferred; investigations only in highly exceptional cases (loss of life, human rights violations, serious social harm)
conflict_or_note: Earlier Nov 2025 notice framed it as grace before fines only. Not in Act or Decree.
